Spring tulips

Tulips prefer well-drained soil and a sunny position. Plant bulbs in autumn at three times their own depth, water sparingly through winter, and mulch once shoots appear. Deadhead after flowering but leave the foliage to die back naturally so the bulb stores energy for next year.

Companion planting with forget-me-nots hides fading leaves, and a yearly top-dress of compost keeps the bed productive. Lift and divide congested clumps every third season, discarding any soft or spotted bulbs before replanting the healthy ones in fresh ground.
